snippet.title: Humanize Robotics - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Physics platformer where a robot controls its own body using its brain. You command the robot. Set the destination, and its neural network battles physics. Struggle through brutal levels, evolve, and master the chaos of movement. Lose a leg? Keep crawling! The Company is watching...
